2608.24683.title: One Timeline, Many Renderings: A Wolfram Language Paclet for heterogeneous musical output
2608.24683.paper_summary: One algorithmic composition may require a Csound score, engraved notation, real-time control, and a rehearsal click. Authored separately, their timelines drift. Temporal System is a Wolfram Language paclet that instead compiles one immutable store of typed entities on a rational beat timeline through backend-specific contracts. It emits Csound synthesis, beta MusicXML 4.0, OSC control, and click artifacts that remain synchronized because they share that store. Conversion to seconds, samples, or hertz occurs only at render time. Csound notes use stable named instruments in external .orc files; curves become k-rate signals declared against score p-fields. The click backend derives rehearsal audio from the same meter and tempo and reuses the Csound serializer. We describe the temporal, semantic, and rendering-contract layers, their practical trade-offs, and the limits of this proprietary authoring environment within an otherwise open-source ecosystem. The archived supplement exposes the reported outputs pending paclet release.
2608.24683.paper_summary_zh: 一個算法作曲可能需要一個 Csound 樂譜、雕刻的樂譜、實時控制和排練點擊。它們分別創作，時間線漂移。Temporal System 是一個 Wolfram Language paclet，它通過後端特定的合約編譯一個不可變的類型實體存儲在有理節拍時間線上。它發出 Csound 合成、beta MusicXML 4.0、OSC 控制和點擊工件，因為它們共享該存儲而保持同步。轉換為秒、樣本或赫茲僅在渲染時進行。Csound 音符在外部 .orc 文件中使用穩定的命名樂器；曲線成為對應於樂譜 p-fields 的 k-rate 信號。點擊後端從相同的拍子和節奏中派生排練音頻並重用 Csound 序列化器。我們描述了時間、語義和渲染合約層，它們的實際權衡，以及在其他開源生態系統中這個專有創作環境的限制。存檔的補充材料揭示了待 paclet 發布的報告輸出。
